fn identity[T](value:T)->T:
    return value
a=identity(2)
b=identity('x')
c=identity(2.5)

fn identity[T](value:T):
    return value
a=identity(2)
b=identity('x')

fn empty[T]()->list[T]:
    return []
a:list[int]=empty()
b:list[str]=empty()

fn first[T](xs:list[T])->T:
    return xs[0]
a=first([1,2])
b=first(['x'])

fn identity[T](value:T)->T:
    return value
a:fn(int)->int=identity
b:fn(str)->str=identity
assert(a(2)==2)

fn identity[T](value:T=1)->T:
    return value
a=identity()
b=identity('x')

fn maybe[T](value:T|None)->T|None:
    return value
a=maybe(2)
b=maybe('x')

record Box[T]:
    value:T
    fn get(self)->T:
        return self.value
    fn set(mut self,value:T):
        self.value=value
a=Box(1)
a.set(2)
b=Box('x')
b.set('y')
assert(a.get()==2)

record Box[T]:
    value:T
    fn set(self,value:T):
        self.value=value
a=Box(1)

record Box[T]:
    value:T
    fn set(mut self,value:T):
        self.value=value
a=Box(1)
a.set('x')

record Box[T]:
    value:T
    fn pair[U](self,other:U)->tuple[T,U]:
        return (self.value,other)
a=Box(1)
b=a.pair('x')
c=Box('y').pair(2)

record Box[T]:
    value:T
fn unwrap_box[T](box:Box[T])->T:
    return box.value
a=unwrap_box(Box(1))
b=unwrap_box(Box('x'))

record Box[T]:
    value:T
record Holder:
    box:Box[int]
a=Holder(Box(1))

record Box[T]:
    value:T
a=Box(Box(1))
b:Box[Box[int]]=a

record Node[T]:
    value:T
    children:list[Node[T]]
a:Node[int]=Node(1,[])

record Node[T]:
    next:Node[T]
a:Node[int]=Node(1)

record Bad[T]:
    next:Bad[T]
fn use(value:Bad[int]):

record R[T]:

fn f[T](value:T,items:list[T]=[])->list[T]:
    append(items,value)
    return items
a=f(1)
b=f('x')

fn f[T](value:T,other:T|None=None)->T|None:
    return other
a=f(1)
b=f('x')

record Box[T]:
    value:T

        return items

record R[T]:
    value:T
    fn f[U](self,a:U,b:U)->U:
        return a
x=R(1)
x.f(1,'x')

record R[T]:
    value:T
    fn f[U](mut self,a:U)->U:
        return a
x=R(1)
x.f('x')
x.f(2)

fn use[S](items:S,initial:S.Item)->S.Item:
    return initial
a=use([1],0)
b=use({'x':1},'key')
